title: Fair Housing Act - protected classes
facts: The federal Fair Housing Act prohibits housing discrimination because of race, color, national origin, religion, sex, familial status and disability in covered housing activities.
The Act applies to conduct including many rentals, sales, mortgage-lending activities and housing-related advertising, subject to statutory exemptions.
HUD accepts and investigates housing-discrimination complaints and other federal agencies or courts can have roles depending on the claim.
State and local fair-housing laws can protect additional classes beyond the federal list.
